articles.title: The Phillies are forced to get creative with their pitching vs. the Braves. Will it work again?
articles.description: In 2023, the Phillies faced a similar pitching conundrum when they opened with Ranger Suárez in Atlanta. The move paid off. They’re hoping it works with Jesús Luzardo in Game 1.

articles.title: Jesús Luzardo returned — as a reliever, and he’ll give the Phillies ‘whatever they need’ in the playoffs
articles.description: Luzardo, who hadn't pitched since Sept. 7, is viewing the playoffs as a fresh start, or him and his injury, as well as for the team.

articles.title: Cristopher Sánchez is the reason to believe in the Phillies after a stunning Game 1 loss to Braves
articles.description: It will come as no surprise the Phillies' issues begin in a bullpen that has been short on arms all season. Now, they’ll need to win two straight games with a closer who threw 27 pitches in Game 1.

articles.title: Phillies-Rays: John Kruk out, Cole Hamels in on NBC Sports Philadelphia for wild-card fight
articles.description: NBC Sports Philadelphia will have a bit of a broadcast shuffle as the Phillies look to clinch a wild-card spot.

articles.title: Alec Bohm, Phillies find their power late to beat the Braves and force a Game 3
articles.description: Down 3-1 in the eighth inning, the Phillies got back-to-back homers from Kyle Schwarber and Bryce Harper before Alec Bohm gave them the lead for good in the 10th. The deciding Game 3 is Thursday.

articles.title: Don’t blame Don Mattingly for the Phillies’ Game 1 collapse. Can the season be saved?
articles.description: Monday could have been avoided had the Phils added more last winter or been more aggressive at the trade deadline.

articles.title: Alec Bohm saves the season for the Phillies. Re-sign him.
articles.description: The polarizing corner infielder homered in the 10th and extended the season. The Phillies should extend his tenure.

articles.title: Austin Riley’s ‘dagger’ three-run homer lifts Braves to 5-3 victory over Phillies in Game 1
articles.description: This time, it was the Phillies’ most reliable arm that faltered, as the bullpen blew yet another late postseason lead.

articles.title: Short of a Cristopher Sánchez complete game, the Phillies will again face the issue that cost them Game 1
articles.description: The Phillies will pin their hopes to Sánchez in Game 2, but the conundrum of how to get the last three, six, or more outs from a few trustworthy options again awaits Don Mattingly.

articles.title: Phillies playoffs: Schedule, tickets, opponent, and everything else you need to know
articles.description: The Phillies are officially heading back to the MLB playoffs, though it feels more like avoiding a disaster than something to be celebrated. Philly clinched the National League’s final wild-card spot ...

articles.title: At second base, Queen Latifah? John Kruk’s revelation, broadcast magic highlight Phillies-Braves broadcast
articles.description: So just how far back do Kruk and Queen Latifah go? Also, the broadcasters seemingly reverse-jinxed J.T. Realmuto ... and Austin Riley.
